steps.code:
access_token = login_resp['access_token']
# Fetch all playlists (public and private) by paginating
all_playlists = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    resp = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not resp:
        break
    all_playlists.extend(resp)
    if len(resp) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1
print(f"Total playlists: {len(all_playlists)}")
# Collect unique song_ids across all playlists
unique_song_ids = set()
for pl in all_playlists:
    unique_song_ids.update(pl['song_ids'])
print(f"Unique songs: {len(unique_song_ids)}")

# Fetch details for each unique song and count artists
from collections import Counter
artist_counts = Counter()
for song_id in unique_song_ids:
    song = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=song_id)
    for artist in song['artists']:
        artist_counts[artist['name']] += 1
print(artist_counts)
